summary: Getty Realty Corp., through subsidiary Getty Leasing, Inc., entered a September 22, 2026 purchase and sale agreement with Refuel Operating Company, LLC and Blue Horseshoe 2, LLC to acquire 41 convenience store properties in Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Texas for approximately $260.9 million; the acquisition closed simultaneously with signing. Getty funded the purchase with forward equity proceeds, unsecured debt, and property disposition proceeds. The properties were leased back to Refuel under four 20-year unitary triple net leases, guaranteed by FR Refuel, LLC, with five-year rent escalations. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch sale-leaseback tenant credit and rent coverage.
